# GitHub Actions CI/CD Demo

A simple CI pipeline using GitHub Actions.  
This project demonstrates automated testing using Python and pytest.

## 🚀 Features
- GitHub Actions workflow
- Automated testing
- Python application
- Clean CI pipeline

## 📁 Project Structure
- app.py — sample Python app
- requirements.txt — dependencies
- .github/workflows/ci.yml — CI pipeline

## ▶️ How It Works
1. Push code to the `main` branch
2. GitHub Actions automatically:
   - Checks out code
   - Installs dependencies
   - Runs tests

## 🛠️ Technologies Used
- GitHub Actions
- Python
- Pytest
- CI/CD
